title: hp-4: tests for slot table, hotplug arrival/departure, C_WaitForSlotEvent
description: Add to test/wp11_test_pkcs11.c: test_slot_table_count (soft slot always slot 0), test_slot_info_soft_token (CKF_TOKEN_PRESENT), test_wait_for_slot_event_no_event (CKF_DONT_BLOCK returns CKR_NO_EVENT), test_hotplug_arrival_mock (inject arrival, verify GetSlotList count increases, verify CKF_TOKEN_PRESENT on new slot), test_hotplug_departure_mock (inject departure, verify CKF_TOKEN_PRESENT cleared, verify open sessions invalidated). Uses WOLFP11_CFG_TEST wp11_test_inject_hotplug() hook.
